notes.title: Wrapping Up the Playtest
notes.notes:
Hello Goblin Gang! Joel and I want to thank everyone who has participated in the public playtest. Your feedback, bug reports, and encouragement have helped us find the fun in our silly goblin game. 

We have already closed the public playtest to new players, and we will be cutting off access to the playtest build at the end of the week, on Friday October 4th.

Fear not, we’ve taken everything we learned and pumped it all into Watch Out for Goblins! The Demo! which will be available to play on October 14th. We are looking forward to participating in NextFest and having the opportunity to share WOFG! with more players on Steam. More players means more feedback, more feedback helps us iterate and make the game better. We wouldn’t be where we are today without your help- and we won’t get where we want to be without building a community that is as excited about our wacky goblin game as we are. Over the next months we are looking forward to reaching new players and gathering new insights about what parts of the game are resonating with people.

That said, we remember who was first in, who was finding the bugs in those early builds so poorly optimized they made GPUs cry. We remember those who climbed Mount Glimbo, who looked out across the barren stretch of Gobland while the UI was cut off by the edge of the screen, and said “this janky game could really be something cool someday.” We believe that too! So, to anyone who’s joined us on our playtest journey- thank you from the bottom of our hearts. It means a lot to us to have your support. 

We hope you will continue to follow along as Watch Out for Goblins! continues to grow. You can find updates on [url=https://sqyd.studio/]our website at SQYD.studio[/url], or by following [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2887920/Watch_Out_For_Goblins/]Watch Out for Goblins! here on Steam[/url]. If you’d like to chat with us we are active [url=https://discord.gg/a5GtRbtnUe]in our casual Discord server[/url] and we are always happy to connect about game dev, goblins, dogs, or whatever. We hope to see you there.  

One more time, because the best things come in threes, thank you. We couldn’t have done it without you. 

Until next time, Watch Out for Goblins!

notes.title: The Last Major Playtest Build
notes.notes:
Hi Goblin Gang! First of all, I wanted to thank everyone who has played and provided us feedback over the last few weeks. You helped us find and fix a lot of bugs, and learn a lot of things about the game. What’s the main thing we learned? The game is too hard! 

We’ve got a lot of changes in this new build- which will likely be the last major playtest update before we launch the demo. If you want to keep helping us out, please give the new build a try and let us know what you think.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Smoother Camera:[/b] Fixed some camera blends that were causing the camera to fly across the map, especially when first loading into the level. 
[*] [b]No More Immortality:[/b] Opening the menu when your goblin was about to drown would result in goblin immortality. Now it doesn't.
[*] [b]Spicy Spawn:[/b] Sometimes on spawn your goblin would get hurled into the sludge. This shouldn’t be happening anymore. 
[*] [b]Jump Sticking:[/b] There was a bug in the animator that was causing the goblin’s jump to stop charging until the goblin falls off a cliff or opens the goblin menu. This doesn't happen anymore (I hope, I’m pretty sure I fixed it this time for real). 
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]More, better checkpoints: [/b]We’ve added more checkpoints to the map, and you no longer have to activate them. Just plug a cog into the connected widget and the attached checkpoint activates automatically. 
[*] [b]New GFX settings:[/b] The quality settings that were on the GFX menu now have more effect than they did before. We’ve also added options for different screen resolutions, and fullscreen/windowed more. These should help the game run smoother on older PCs.
[*] [b]Goblin select screen:[/b] Added an option to re-roll your goblin- get more names and random a costume (based on the Garb you’ve already collected). We also added an “Inverted Look” control scheme that’s always available for people who prefer it. You can still change 
[*] [b]A load screen:[/b]  A proper load screen that hides the level while it’s being set up. It’s even got tooltips! I love tooltips. 
[*] [b]Sludge Goblins:[/b] These are spooky goons that you can blast, punch, and kick. They menace you slowly and drop mud when they die. 
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks and changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Nerfed the sludge:[/b] The sludge sucked. We’ve nerfed it across the board. It does less damage, slows you down less, and lets you jump out of it more easily. Sludge damage now drains while you are outside of the sludge. Overall missing a jump should be much more forgiving.
[*] [b]Charged up the jump:[/b] Added a new jump animation to make the jump look more like a jump. Also increased the min and max jump forces, just to give the goblins a bit of extra pep. 
[*] [b]NPCs talk less:[/b] Cut the NPC dialogue a bunch (I tend to overwrite, can you tell?). They now have less to say, and once you’ve exhausted their lines they just repeat the last one instead of looping through everything again. 
[*][b] Reworked the whole level: [/b]The whole level has changed, but mainly we focused on the beginning and the end. The beginning has better signposting to try to show players the critical path, and the end has more options and easier jumps. We also added a bunch more Cogs so players should usually be able to get one when they need it.  
[/list]

[h2]The Bad News[/h2]
This will likely be the last major playtest build. We will be taking the Playtest down on October 2nd, and be replacing it with a public demo sometime before October 14th. Of course this doesn't mean we are done collecting feedback. Quite the opposite! We are hoping that WOFG! The Demo! will help us reach more players who are excited by Watch Out for Goblins!, who can help us as we continue to iterate and improve.

Thank you so much for playtesting. With your help the game keeps getting better.
Until next time- always Watch Out for Goblins!

notes.title: WOFG! Demo Playtest
notes.notes:
Hello Goblin Gang! A new WOFG! public playtest build is here. It’s a big one this time. This build is the “clean draft” of the Watch Out for Goblins! demo. We are going to fix some bugs, make small performance improvements, and maybe add some more FX, transitions, and general polish, but we are pretty darn close to how we want to launch. 

If you’ve played before and want to dive right into the playtest we recommend resetting your game data for the best experience. You can now find that option on the “game” tab of the settings menu. If you want to know more about what’s new, please read on. 

[h2]New Stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Energy Widgets - [/b] A new core mechanic to give you something new to do with those Power Cogs. Put a cog into a widget to power up any attached goblin mechanisms. 
[*] [b]NPC “Quest Lines” - [/b]The goblins on the map now have behavior/dialogue that progresses as the players explore and interact with Gobland.
[*] [b]Climbing -[/b] We’ve added some new animations that let the goblins climb. The feature is a proof of concept at the moment, and it doesn't always work. It’s never required to complete any of the demo content. We think with some better animations it will really shine. 
[*] [b]Menu Changes -[/b] As above, the “reset game data” button has been moved to the settings menu under the “game” tab. It even has a popup to confirm if you are sure. The “respawn” and “rejoin” options have also been removed from the pause menu. Unfortunately, this means you will now have to return to the main menu to add or remove a player. 
[*] [b]Save Changes - [/b]Game progress now saves whenever a player collects or spends a Power Cog. Save data now gets “cleaned” when it is loaded- this should make it easier to add content without ruining player’s save data.
[*] [b]Level Design - [/b]This is the big one. We made a lot of changes to the Skrimble Isles map. It really feels like a full and complete level in a video game now. Can you grab the Power Cogs you need to activate all eight Energy Widgets?
[/list]

[h2]Bad News[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]One Map -[/b] This build only includes the Skrmible Isles map. We want to focus playtesting on the most complete part of the game as we aim to get our demo ready. Mount Glimbo and the Racetrack may someday return- but for now they are out.  
[*] [b]End of the Playtest -[/b] We will be ending the WOFG! public playtest at the end of the month. Fear not, the WOFG! demo will replace it in early October.      
[/list]

If you’ve been playing along with the open playtest, we’d love to hear your feedback on this latest build. When you quit the playtest you will be asked if you want to fill out a short survey about your experience. Please fill it out. Any feedback you have, good and bad, will help make WOFG! better.

Thank you to everybody who’s already playtested and provided their feedback. It’s helped us learn what’s working and what isn’t. We appreciate you and your interest in our little goblin game. Until next time, as always, Watch Out for Goblins!

notes.title: WOFG August 8th 2024 - The Goblin Menu Update
notes.notes:
Hello Goblin Gang! We’ve been hard at work getting more features ready as we work towards our demo for Next Fest in October. Here’s what’s changed in this update: 

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[h3]Goblin menu[/h3]
[list]
[*] Open the goblin menu by pressing select (or tab, on mouse and keyboard). You can do all sorts of fun stuff with this menu.
[*] Customize your goblin! We have a cosmetics system. Show off your goblin style with a bunch of cosmetic options in customizable colors.
[*] Respawn your goblin at any checkpoint you’ve previously activated.
[*] See a list of all power cogs in the scene, and which ones you’ve collected.
[*] Read the tutorial pages any time you want. 
[/list]  

[h3]Control stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rebindable Controls - You can rebind gameplay controls from the settings menu, this is currently tied to your player profile, but will soon be tied to your player goblin. To prevent players from softlocking themselves you can’t rebind UI controls.
[*] Dynamic input prompts - Input prompts should now update to reflect the correct controls. This means keyboard players should get keyboard prompts. These should also update if controls are rebound.
[/list]

[h3]IK stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added IK to the goblins hands while grabbing. This makes the goblins reach for the nearest object while grabbing. This makes it much easier to grab stuff in mid air.  
[*] Added some look at IK to goblin NPC behaviors. It just makes them look a bit more lively.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where force respawning while in the sludge would cause an “anti-gravity” effect. 
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused goblins to trip while sprinting on flat ground. 
[/list]

[h2]The bad news[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have made the decision to reduce the number of supported players from four to two. There are a few reasons for this. The main one is performance- rendering is our biggest bottle neck and we want the game to be able to run well even on older PCs.   
[*] This might be disappointing to you, it is for us, but we feel it's best for the game to make this decision early. 
[*] We are fully committed to supporting two player split-screen. We love couch co-op games and it’s very important to us that we are able to play WOFG! together.
[/list]

I think that’s all for now. Thanks again for participating in the open playtest. Until next time: Watch Out for Goblins!

notes.title: July 3rd Update Notes
notes.notes:
I see at least a few of you have a lot of playtime in the current playtest build. That’s awesome. I’ve included all three in development maps in this new update. Nothing is finished, but it should give you plenty of new content to play with.

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Racetrack map is back- this is where I test all my new features.
[*] The Skrimble Isles map is here to- plan is this map will eventually become our demo level.
[*] New Goblin NPC behaviors. They talk to you now, and feel much more lively overall. 
[*] New sprint system. Hold X and forward to dash, let go and you’ll keep sprinting. Be careful as dashing consumes stamina. Don’t knock yourself out. 
[*] New stamina/health UI. 
[*] Bunch of new sound FX.
[*] Giant flies that will try to ram you into the sludge. The model is a prototype and they have no SFX yet.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the goblin repining bugs that were “pulling” the goblin out of place after landing on slopes.
[*] Goblins are now correctly removed from minigame trackers after the minigame ends. 
[*] Fixed most respawning bugs. Goblins shouldn’t be spawning underground. At least I hope not. 
[*] Fixed a bug on rejoining where the first player goblin would ignore gravity.
[*] Other small bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Things I didn’t get around to fixing (but are still on the list):[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jump and punch UI are still buggy as anything. 
[*] Player prompts are still all for a gamepad. Keyboard is supported, but you have to figure out the buttons on your own. XD
[*] Toggling in and out of the sprint still causes the camera to jumpcut. It’s less noticeable now that the sprint mechanics have changed but I still want to clean it up at some point. 
[/list]

Thank you so much for playtesting. Your feedback is helping us make WOFG! The best game it can be. If you notice anything you want to let us know about you can post it to the Steam community boards here:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2973890/ ] WOFG! Playtest Steam Community [/url]
We also have a modest discord server if you’d like to chat with us devs directly: 
[url=https://discord.gg/a5GtRbtnUe ] SQYD.studio Discord Server [/url]
Until next time remember to Watch Out for Goblins!

notes.title: WOFG! Now with Wind!
notes.notes:
Small update mostly tweaks, but one new thing to play with:
[list]
[*]System to add physics effects to trigger zones, in this update we use this to make some big fans to blow your goblins around.
[*]More work on sound effects. Collision SFX now scale with impact damage. Fixed some bugs causing SFX not to play sometimes.
[*]Settings tweaks to give players better control of the goblin. 
[/list]

notes.title: Fixes for Game Crashing Bugs
notes.notes:
A small patch to fix a major issue, and some small menu bugs. 

[list]
[*]Fix for game locking up when respawning/rejoining goblins with 2+ players. 
[*]Menu fixes so all the menu options work as intended (back button on settings, selecting options with the game pad or mouse, and resume button on pause menu).
[*]Main menu now forces the game to single player, so it can be navigated by any input device.
[*]Respawning/Rejoining now cancels any mini-game currently playing. You can end a race you are bored of from the start menu.   
[/list]

notes.title: WOFG! Playtest Changelog 0.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added tutorial area and pages to teach players how to play.
[*] Changes to physics settings to better stabilize goblin ragdolls.
[*] Bug fixes for bugs caused by re-spawning goblins. 
[*] More sound effects and improvements to the SFX system for split-screen multiplayer.
[*] Added prompts to activate minigames in multiplayer. Minigames no longer require all goblins to gather in one place before they can start. 
[*] New background music.
[*] Smaller performance optimizations and bug fixes.
[/list]
